learned_patterns.name: Stable filenames for CRM web-resource bundles
learned_patterns.context: Vite builds packaged as Dynamics web resources
learned_patterns.pattern: Disable content hashing for web-resource builds. CRM's own /{orgCustomizationVersion}/webresources/ path token busts cache on Publish, and stable names keep the solution manifest and the deployed record set from accumulating orphans.

learned_patterns.name: Build-time module swap for the in-CRM renderer
learned_patterns.context: Reusing one React renderer across the portal and an in-CRM web resource
learned_patterns.pattern: Keep a single renderer and swap the data-access modules at build time via a dedicated Vite config, so the portal talks to the Node backend and the web resource talks to Xrm.WebApi without forking the component tree.

common_mistakes.mistake: Consuming @qdb/shared from a Vite config that lacks the alias
common_mistakes.symptom: White page. The bundle downloads but never executes — a value-import produces a module-graph SyntaxError that kills it silently.
common_mistakes.prevention: Every Vite config consuming @qdb/shared needs the alias to shared/src/server.ts, matching the frontend config. Fixed in 3e1a9bb after the issue was parked for days as 'root cause unknown'.
common_mistakes.cost: days of parked debugging across two engagements

common_mistakes.mistake: Appending a cache-busting query string to web-resource asset URLs
common_mistakes.prevention: The on-prem web resource handler rejects query strings outright. Never emit ?v= — use the platform's path token.

common_mistakes.mistake: Reading a lookup grid column by its plain attribute name
common_mistakes.symptom: Lookup cells render blank while text columns are fine
common_mistakes.prevention: Web API returns _<attr>_value plus a FormattedValue annotation. Remap the label into values[attr] — grid cells read that directly with no fallback.

common_mistakes.mistake: Looking up a DOM anchor by a config GUID with case-sensitive getElementById
common_mistakes.symptom: Section navigation silently no-ops — config GUIDs are often uppercase, DOM ids lowercase
common_mistakes.prevention: Match case-insensitively and use the definition's own id. Also resolve the owning tab and switch to it before scrolling, with a rAF retry until the anchor renders.

common_mistakes.mistake: Verifying a republished bundle on a normal reload
common_mistakes.symptom: Old behaviour persists after a correct fix
common_mistakes.prevention: Ctrl+F5. The browser caches the previous web-resource bundle.

preferred_approaches.scenario: Adding a field to a shared form type
preferred_approaches.approach: Edit both shared/src/types/form.types.ts (backend + frontend) and form.ts (mobile), make it optional, and let the parity check at shared/scripts/check-shared-type-sync.mjs gate the build.
preferred_approaches.rationale: The two files are resolved by different tsconfig paths; editing one leaves the other package blind to the field.
